decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Location Plan received on 01/10/2014, Existing elevations, existing floor plans, proposed floor plans (with proposed site plan) and proposed outbuilding elevation and plans received 07/10/2014, proposed front elevation of boundary wall and plan of front drive received on 14/11/2014 and Proposed elevations received on 25/11/2014) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority (including details of the proposed roof windows to the rear extension).  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extension hereby approved and outbuilding hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building or outbuilding without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The windows formed in the side elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
Condition : 6 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 91 St Stephens Road TW3 2BJ.
description: Erection of a single storey rear and front extensions to convert garage to a habitable room, alterations to front boundary wall, widening of hard standing and erection of a single storey outbuilding at the rear garden of the house
